task: FV2-047 — Reset stale speaker test feedback after output device changes
summary: The local speaker-check result is tied to the selected output device. Changing its ID or label clears previous feedback, and a delayed completion from an earlier output cannot publish stale success/error state. The control remains busy until the in-flight playback completes, preventing overlapping speaker checks.
